description: Machine-readable enumeration of every fail-closed gate enforced by deploy.sh, in the exact order they run. Prompt 024 (150-prompt deploy-hardening program). Each gate's "marker" is a literal substring that must appear in deploy.sh — tests/Feature/ReleaseChecklistDriftTest.php asserts every marker is still present and still ordered exactly as listed here, so this file cannot silently drift out of sync with the script it documents.

gates.description: Current directory contains artisan, composer.json and .git — refuses an incomplete copy or the wrong working directory before anything else runs.
The checked-out Git HEAD exactly matches the operator-supplied expected SHA.
No uncommitted or staged content drift on tracked release files (mode-only noise from this script's own prior chmod is explicitly ignored via core.fileMode=false).
APP_KEY is already configured; this script never generates or rotates it.
The configured database connection is mysql or mariadb, never sqlite, in production.
gates.marker: Production DB_CONNECTION must be mysql or mariadb

gates.description: No pending migrations — this script has no Backup V2 wiring, so a schema-changing release must stop here rather than migrate first and back up later.

Prompt 8 (100-prompt Kairus program). Freshly rebuilt config:cache resolves every storage_path()-based value (log/session/cache/disk paths) under this exact release directory, not a directory from a different release — see App\Services\Deploy\CachedConfigPathAudit.

Release-managed static assets (config('deploy.asset_drift_scan_paths')) match on content, permission and non-emptiness between the application root and the configured served document root — see App\Services\Deploy\PublicAssetDriftDetector. A no-op when DEPLOY_SERVED_PUBLIC_ROOT is unset.

post_gate_actions.description: Only after every gate above has passed: write REVISION and DEPLOY_INFO (metadata only, never secrets) for the newly verified release.

Optional, append-only, cross-release history (Prompt 7, 100-prompt Kairus program) — records this release's revision to config('deploy.release_registry_path') (DEPLOY_RELEASE_REGISTRY_PATH) when configured, since REVISION/DEPLOY_INFO are discarded on the next release. Never blocks the release: a no-op when unconfigured, only a warning on any other failure.
